summary: Read the complete 110238-character markdown, including all supplementary materials, and checked the 17 requested estimates against their cited PDF pages (11, 12, 15, 16, 43, 52, and 53), with additional methodological checks on pp. 10, 13, and 14. All recorded statistics and non-null participant counts match the printed values and belong to the stated outcomes, arms, and contrasts. The fourteen linguistic records appropriately leave analysis counts null because Tables 5-6 do not establish their counts and the reported statistics are inconsistent with the assigned-arm counts; no sample sizes or regrouping were inferred. The three Bayesian records retain the printed posterior contrasts, HDIs, BF01 values, and applicable control intercepts without importing observed means from another analysis. All five supplied script warnings are false positives against the supplied rules: measure=length is explicitly allowed in codebook Section 6 and fits total words; se_basis=unclear is explicitly allowed in Section 10 and the extraction-spec field notes, and is appropriate because the Bayesian response unit and full hierarchy are not established. Ten measure-code mismatches remain: eight word-category counts coded automated_score and two common-word percentages coded lexical_overlap. Their numerical values and scope are correct, but placeholder codes do not satisfy the supplied definitions; no replacement code was guessed. No additional in-scope outcome or reported full-sample contrast is missing under rules 4-6. The remaining requested fields are consistent with the paper and codebook.
